title: Floors as terraces
prompt:
REFERENCE IMAGE ROLES:
— the previous frame of this storyboard. BASE IMAGE: edit it as instructed; everything the instruction does not change stays exactly as it is.
— a gold emblem on black: an open circle broken at the upper right, crossed by a level bar and a steep slanted bar that meet in a small stepped block. OBJECT REFERENCE: this is the Thoughtform brand mark. Reproduce its shape exactly.

Edit the base image. Change ONE thing: the tops of the two left sectors become open-plan office floors stepping down like terraces, each slice a full floor plate with desks, meeting tables and tiny people, clearly legible as the floors of an office building. The right sectors stay as they are. Keep exactly everything else: the drum of stacked slices and its walls, the four sectors and their contents (offices with people on the left, gold circuits on the right), the gold crescent, the two gaps and the stepped block, the fraying raster lines at the upper left, the camera, the near-black ground, the palette (bone white, muted gold, sage green only) and the hairline line weight. No words or letters.
